issues.reproduction: Run the real UIA find against a top-level ChatGPT window.
issues.expected: A top-level match returns without enumerating an unrelated descendant tree.
issues.actual: The descendant provider could block the find until timeout.
issues.rootCause: Top-level matching happened only after descendant enumeration.
issues.fix: Match each top-level window first and return at the requested limit.

issues.reproduction: Launch the isolated desktop and inspect Restart Supervisor immediately after boot.
issues.expected: The companion uses portable Node and the first visible health state reports it running.
issues.actual: Electron could be used as Node and boot-time cached health reported no companion during the pid-file race.
issues.rootCause: The portable executable/state directory were not passed through the plugin host, and health was cached before companion startup.
issues.fix: Pass portable Node/stateDir, retain spawned PID until the file arrives, and refresh health after startup.

issues.reproduction: Run a command through the real isolated UI with the repository as workspace.
issues.expected: TEMP is on D: and outside the protected workspace.
issues.actual: Desktop/runtime hardcoded TEMP beneath the repository, so the command sandbox rejected it.
issues.rootCause: Three launch paths derived TEMP from the checkout instead of a same-volume sibling.
issues.fix: Centralize same-volume disjoint TEMP resolution and use `D:\Hns-Integration-RC\temp`.

issues.reproduction: Open Settings -> Mega with built-in plugins installed from file dependencies.
issues.expected: Installed versions match their tested pins.
issues.actual: The local `file:` path was compared with a semantic version and shown as drift.
issues.rootCause: The profile declaration was used as the version instead of the materialized package manifest.
issues.fix: Resolve file dependencies through the installed package.json version.

issues.reproduction: Run the full combined acceptance after the final regression.
issues.expected: Phase C improvement is at least 1.2x and all 51 checks pass.
issues.actual: 50/51 passed; Phase C measured 1.189x. A prior isolated rerun measured 1.212x, showing threshold-edge variance but not replacing the failed full run.
issues.rootCause: Measured performance remains too close to the gate to be reliably accepted.

issues.reproduction: Run the repository Qualification suite, then audit C:\Users\15601\AppData\Local\Temp and project-owned processes.
issues.expected: All controllable test scratch, runtime data, and child processes stay under D:\Hns-Integration-RC and terminate.
issues.actual: Runtime/restart test scratch roots and dsh-sub-worker-tests were written beneath the default C-drive Temp tree; one D-drive Node runtime Host remained alive with a C-drive test checkout/data root.
issues.rootCause: Some tests derive scratch from os.tmpdir or LOCALAPPDATA; at least the sub-worker test explicitly uses LOCALAPPDATA rather than the task-local D-drive root. The shutdown scenario also failed to reap its child.
issues.cleanup: Stopped PID 54124 and deleted its three generated files. Empty test directories remain after host policy rejected directory deletion.
